insights.title: Idle app repaints 21 frames/s
insights.detail: With nothing happening the app still writes 10.5 KB/s to the terminal and uses 2.8% of a core. Ambient work is dominated by _tui_api._clock_run (18 ms/3 s), tui.set_text (14 ms/3 s), _tui._calc_bounds (14 ms/3 s). 48% of it is forks and external programs.

insights.title: Input handling spawns processes on 10 interaction types
insights.detail: Hover, focus and click should be fork-free (a fork costs ~1 ms, an awk ~4 ms). Command palette close: 12.0 forks + 6.0 programs; Command palette open: 5.0 forks + 2.0 programs; Wheel scroll, burst: 4.5 forks + 2.2 programs; Mouse click: 4.6 forks + 2.0 programs; Wheel scroll, single: 4.0 forks + 2.0 programs.

insights.title: Page switch, first visit is over budget
insights.detail: Page switch, first visit takes 356 ms (budget 150 ms, 2.4×). 23% of it runs in Subprocesses.

insights.detail: Page switch, revisit takes 370 ms (budget 100 ms, 3.7×). 23% of it runs in Subprocesses.

insights.title: `stat` is the most expensive external program (186 runs, 220 ms per scenario pass)

insights.title: alt+2 does not switch pages on a warm start
insights.detail: The demo binds alt+1..0 in _nav.xml, but the key is dispatched with no binding found (handled in <1 ms, no page change). Mouse navigation works.

insights.title: Warm start takes 857 ms
insights.detail: Largest phase: load cache (354 ms).

insights.title: 24% of interaction time is forks and external programs
insights.detail: Bash builtins and parameter expansion do the same jobs without a process.
